CITY OF LAVERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  May 13, 2026 - 6:30 PM
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

CALL TO ORDER
Vice-Chair Duffy called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
Led by Commissioner Chang

ROLL CALL
Commissioners present: Carney, Chang, Duffy, Ramos
Absent: Conrad
Advisory Staff present: Planning Manager Candice Bowcock, Assistant City Attorney Lisa Kranitz,
and Secretary Natalie Hiatt

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

1.  Planning Commission Minutes of the Regular meeting of April 8, 2026.
  Recommendation: That the Planning Commission approve the minutes of the April 8, 2026
  meeting.
Approved

PUBLIC COMMENT
This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission on items not listed
in any other place on this agenda. California Law does not allow the Planning Commission to take
action in response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to staff or set
for hearing at a later date.
None

PUBLIC HEARING

2.  17-Unit Condominium Conversion Request for a Conditional Use Permit and Tentative Tract
  Map to convert a previously approved and constructed 17-unit residential rental development
  into a for-sale condominium project. The request would subdivide the development into
  seventeen (17) individual airspace condominium units and associated common areas to be
  maintained by a homeowners association.
   CASE NO.:  29-26CUP, 30-26TTM

  RESOLUTION NO.:  1356
  APPLICANT:  MW INVESTMENT GROUP, LLC

  PROPOSAL:  A REQUEST FOR A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT AND
  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TO CONVERT A PREVIOUSLY
  APPROVED AND CONSTRUCTED 17-UNIT RESIDENTIAL
  RENTAL DEVELOPMENT INTO A FOR-SALE
  CONDOMINIUM PROJECT. THE REQUEST WOULD
  SUBDIVIDE THE DEVELOPMENT INTO (17) INDIVIDUAL
  CONDOMINIUM UNITS AND ASSOCIATED COMMON
  AREAS TO BE MAINTAINED BY A HOMEOWNERS
  ASSOCIATION.
  ADDRESS:  2109 N. WHITE AVENUE
  STAFF:  Candice Bowcock, Planning Manager
  Recommendation:

  Staff and the Development Review Committee recommend approval to the Planning
  Commission for Case Nos. 29-26CUP and 30-26TTM, subject to the attached Conditions of
  Approval.

Vice-Chair Duffy opened the Public Hearing and Planning Manager Candice Bowcock reported on
the item. Ms. Bowcock stated that representatives were present on behalf of the applicant Matt
Waken.

Public Comment: Richard Bowen and Janelle Gray.

Commissioner Discussion/Comments: The Commissioners asked questions regarding tenant
noticing and moving expenses.

It was moved by Commissioner Ramos and seconded by Commissioner Carney to approve the item
with modifications to Tenant Relocation Assistance Conditions 8, 9, and 10a. Motion carried by a 4-
0 vote (Chairperson Conrad absent).

3.  Capital Improvement Plan 2026/27 The City of La Verne continues to prepare and adopt a
  Capital Improvement Plan as a part of the annual budget and to more responsibly plan for long
  range capital improvements. A comprehensive Capital Improvement Plan such as this requires,
  per State law, review by the Planning Commission for consistency with the adopted General
  Plan. The proposed next fiscal year (2026/27) Capital Improvement Plan lists all capital
  improvements and special projects to be undertaken.
  CASE NO.:  N/A
  RESOLUTION NO.:  1357
  STAFF:  Candice Bowcock, Planning Manager
  Recommendation:
   Staff recommends the Planning Commission review the proposed Capital Improvement Plan,
  and adopt Resolution No. 1357, certifying that the proposed Capital Improvement Plan, for year
  (2026/27) is consistent with the adopted General Plan.

Vice-Chair Duffy opened the Public Hearing and Ms. Bowcock reported on the item.

Public Comments: Richard Bowen

It was moved by Commissioner Chang and seconded by Commissioner Ramos to adopt Resolution
No. 1357, and certifying that the proposed Capital Improvement Plan for year 2026-27 is consistent
with the General Plan. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote (Chairperson Conrad absent).

DIRECTOR COMMENTS
Ms. Bowcock announced that there is a need for a meeting on June 10th.

Commissioner Comments: Commissioner Chang asked if the City has a fire noticing and
monitoring program. Ms. Bowcock recommended using the Watch Duty app and stated that she
would relay the request to the Fire Department.

ADJOURNMENT

4.  The next meeting of the Planning Commission is scheduled to be held June 10, 2026 at
  6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers, 3660 "D" Street, La Verne, CA 91750.
The meeting was adjourned at 7:30 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Natalie Hiatt, Secretary
